newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar closes softer, August dominates.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar closes softer, August dominates.

text.p: LIFFE sugar ended a shade easier on Tuesday after a day of sideways trading, dealers said.
Business was dominated by August which finished at $319.00, down $0.10, while October was off $1.20 at $314.30.
Of a total 3,814 lots traded, 2,883 were on soon to expire front month August.
The market was in pre-expiry mode, with a high proportion of AA trades in the volume and trades rolling positions from August into October playing a big role, traders said.
In Paris, August was down $0.50 at $318.70 while October was off $0.90 at $314.00.
